title: Unlocking Azerbaijan’s TradeTech Potential report | World Economic Forum
gist: A WEF and C4IR Azerbaijan report assesses Azerbaijan's TradeTech ecosystem and sets 10 recommendations around legal recognition of digital trade documents, interoperability and market adoption.

insights.claim: Azerbaijan has built substantial digital and logistics foundations, and the next opportunity is strengthening enabling conditions so they support trade, finance and logistics more effectively.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Positions Azerbaijan as a digital trade corridor candidate.

insights.claim: The report identifies three priorities: legal recognition of digital trade documents, interoperability between government platforms and private actors, and deeper market coordination, solution development and adoption.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Reusable checklist for assessing a country's digital-trade readiness.

insights.claim: It sets out 10 recommendations sequenced from immediate actions in the first 12 months to structural reforms over 12-36 months, based on 28 consultations across 18 organizations.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Gives a timeline for Azerbaijan's TradeTech reforms.
